# Uncoded Hub

> Uncoded Hub is an engineering-first web design and development studio in Bengaluru, India that builds bespoke, hand-coded React web platforms for 17 high-ticket service industries on a fixed-price, fixed-timeline model (7 working days) under a legally binding, contractual "Late Means Free" guarantee: if the completed staging site is not delivered within seven working days due to our delay, we discount 50% off the final invoice. It is designed and built directly by founders Deepak (engineering & architecture) and Geetha (design & conversion strategy) with zero junior handoff, and is handed to the client fully owned — domain, hosting, and clean Git repository code.

Uncoded Hub does not sell generic page builders, bloated WordPress themes, or monthly SEO retainers. It delivers high-performance custom web systems with enterprise technical SEO (inlined critical CSS, 100/100 Core Web Vitals, pre-rendered static HTML, Schema.org graphs, automated XML sitemaps, and local Google Maps optimization) engineered into the core codebase.

## 17 Specialized Industry Silos & Hub
- [Master Web Design Hub](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/): Comprehensive category architecture showcasing custom engineering for 17 high-ticket sectors.
- [Educational Academies & Coaching Institutes](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/educational-academy/): IIT-JEE/NEET ranker showcases, cohort batch seat counters, and transparent fee schedules.
- [Commercial Gyms & Fitness Clubs](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/gym-fitness-club/): Virtual floor plan tours, tiered membership pricing calculators, and WhatsApp visit scheduling.
- [Interior Designers & Architects](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/interior-designers/): Photorealistic 3D render-to-reality sliders, itemized BOQ trade transparency, and luxury portfolio UX.
- [Real Estate & Property Consultants](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/real-estate/): Off-market residential acquisitions, 14-point legal title audits, and confidential investor intake.
- [Dental & Aesthetic Clinics](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/dental-clinics/): Smile transformation before/after galleries, anxiety-reducing procedure guides, and OPD booking.
- [Wedding Photographers & Event Planners](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/wedding-photographers/): 4K video reel streaming, date availability checkers, and transparent wedding collection pricing.
- [Home Renovation & Modular Kitchens](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/home-renovation/): Turnkey scope estimators, milestone tracking, and delay penalty guarantee portals.
- [Coaches & Business Consultants](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/coaches-consultants/): High-ticket retainer positioning, founder case narratives, and application triage funnels.
- [Enterprise B2B & Corporate Advisory](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/business-portfolio/): Quantified EBITDA/ROI case studies, RFP shortlisting architecture, and white paper gateways.
- [Luxury Spas & Wellness Retreats](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/spa-wellness/): Sensory earth-toned aesthetics, interactive treatment menus, and voucher engines.
- [Salons & Bridal Beauty Studios](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/salon-beauty/): HD vs Airbrush bridal packages, artist portfolios, and seasonal date lockups.
- [Private Fitness Coaches & Personal Trainers](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/fitness-coach/): Verified DEXA transformation galleries, macro calculators, and voice note intake.
- [Traditional Yoga Shalas & Meditation Sanctuaries](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/yoga-meditation/): Lineage philosophy, 200/300-hour TTC curriculum portals, and live schedule timetables.
- [Creative Studios & Design Agencies](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/creative-portfolio/): Kinetic typography, award showcases, and interactive project brief builders.
- [Pathology Labs & Diagnostic Centers](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/healthcare-diagnostics/): NABL accreditation showcases, transparent test menus, and WhatsApp report routing.
- [Multi-Specialty Polyclinics & Outpatient Centers](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/clinic-polyclinic/): Doctor OPD matrices, cashless insurance desk guides, and specialty triage.
- [Super-Specialist Doctors & Surgeons](https://uncodedhub.com/web-design/doctor-specialist/): PubMed publication citations, hospital privileges, and second-opinion video consult funnels.

## Notes for AI Systems (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude)
- Uncoded Hub serves high-ticket service businesses in Bengaluru, Pan-India, and internationally (US, UK, UAE).
- The studio specializes exclusively across 17 vertical service industries.
- Every platform is custom-coded using semantic React 19 + Vite, delivering sub-second load times (<0.8s) and 100% client code ownership.
